skill.summary: Japanese content creators create Japanese photos into photo slideshow video using this skill. Accepts JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP up to 200MB, renders on cloud GPUs...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Japanese Photo Video Maker.
- Upload Japanese photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP up to 200MB) and create 1080p MP4 slideshow videos in 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic backend setup and authentication on first use; 100 free credits via anonymous token for 7 days.
- Supports music, text overlays, and transitions; cloud GPU rendering and rapid file export.
- Includes error handling, session management, and easy retrieval of credits, state, and exports.
- Clear instructions for common workflows and troubleshooting.
